57.Check the installation direction of thrust bearing number 2, 
and install it on the underdrive clutch hub.
58.Hold the input shaft, and install the underdrive clutch.
59.Place two beads of solder [each 10 mm (0.39 inch) in 
length, 3.5 mm (0.14 inch) in diameter] on the underdrive 
clutch retainer as shown in the illustration.
60.Install special tool MD998412 in the illustrated place.
61.Install the oil pump to the transaxle case.
NOTE: Do not install the oil pump gasket at this time.
62.Tighten the oil pump mounting bolts (six pieces) to the 
specified torque.
Tightening torque: 23 ± 3 N⋅m (17 ± 2 ft-lb)
